verdict.rationale: Galileo captures every session, trace, and span as a real-time data stream and can alert when cost is higher than expected, which implies it tracks cost on logged traffic. The evidence never shows dashboards that break cost or tokens down by request, model, or time period. Missing for 10: explicit token-usage tracking, cost/token dashboards, per-request/per-model/per-time-period breakdowns, independent or hands-on corroboration.
